blocks.html: Most of the work below was carried out at one industrial CHP plant supplying a refinery in Ploiești, Romania, continuously from 2007 to 2018 and again from 2022.

The plant: three steam boilers of 120 t/h and one circulating fluidized bed boiler of 260 t/h at 100 bar; three steam turbines of 12 MW and one of 30 MW; steam headers at 100, 35, 16, 6 and 1.2 bar with reducing stations between them. Fuels are natural gas, refinery gas and petroleum coke. The refinery takes steam from four headers and electricity from the plant. A photovoltaic park and a wind farm are dispatched together with it.
Knowing a plant for eleven years is a different kind of engineering from delivering a project to it. Nothing below was handed over and forgotten.
Newest first. Years are as recorded by the client.
